description: This file defines the 'SudoCountThings' command class used for counting 'things' without permission checks in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON, managing optional filters, and integrating with the Ditto command framework.

classes.name: SudoCountThings
classes.description: Immutable command class for counting things without permission checks, supporting JSON serialization/deserialization, with optional filters and header management.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new SudoCountThings instance with an optional filter and specified headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a SudoCountThings instance from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Returns the optional filter string that applies to the count operation.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Builds the JSON payload for the command, including the optional filter.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new SudoCountThings instance with updated headers.
